sections.title: باب 7 — متن (21)

paras.text: … effort be made to strengthen value diversity in Pakistan. The role of the media is of great importance. Through newspapers, radio and television awareness and consciousness can be raised among the public. If all the nations of Pakistan are given rights without discrimination and these rights also have constitutional protection, then the foundation of value diversity can be laid. In this regard the distribution of powers should be based on justice. The first duty of the Pakistani leadership is that the bitterness between ethnicities and provinces be ended and justice and equality be used. In Pakistan there is a need for an autonomous and independent judiciary. The absence of justice too is an obstacle to the establishment of value diversity. For acceptable value diversity, besides a dignified and independent judiciary, an acceptable system of justice is needed. When cheap and speedy justice is available, value diversity can be established.

paras.text: The redress of legitimate complaints too is the foundation of value diversity. If any group, sect or area has some legitimate complaint, it is necessary for the government to redress it on a priority basis. From this a sense of security is created among weak and oppressed nationalities and groups. Then they too consider themselves equal citizens of this country. Minorities too live in Pakistan; they will have to be given the status of equal citizens and the protection of minorities will have to be ensured. The protection of the minorities of Pakistan through legal and constitutional methods is necessary. They will have to be made to feel that they are equal citizens of this country. … effort be made to strengthen value diversity in Pakistan. The role of the media is of great importance. Through newspapers, radio and television awareness and consciousness can be raised among the public. If all the nations of Pakistan are given rights without discrimination and these rights also have constitutional protection, then the foundation of value diversity can be laid. In this regard the distribution of powers should be based on justice. The first duty of the Pakistani leadership is that the bitterness between ethnicities and provinces be ended and justice and equality be used. In Pakistan there is a need for an autonomous and independent judiciary. The absence of justice too is an obstacle to the establishment of value diversity. For acceptable value diversity, besides a dignified and independent judiciary, an acceptable system of justice is needed. When cheap and speedy justice is available, value diversity can be established.

The redress of legitimate complaints too is the foundation of value diversity. If any group, sect or area has some legitimate complaint, it is necessary for the government to redress it on a priority basis. From this a sense of security is created among weak and oppressed nationalities and groups. Then they too consider themselves equal citizens of this country. Minorities too live in Pakistan; they will have to be given the status of equal citizens and the protection of minorities will have to be ensured. The protection of the minorities of Pakistan through legal and constitutional methods is necessary. They will have to be made to feel that they are equal citizens of this country. Today Pakistan needs a strong value diversity as perhaps it never did before. In it lies the development and prosperity of Pakistan and the Pakistani people.

Life Style That Promotes Diversity and Tolerance in Society

The style of life should be made such as to become the cause of diversity and tolerance in society. It is better that the style of life and social values be based on Islamic principles; then negative diversity can be reduced and uniformity can be created in diversity. We need to adopt Islamic culture, where every Muslim is the brother of another Muslim. Besides this, non-Muslims too should have an honourable place. We [need] conduct based on justice. Islam teaches human equality. When equality is blended into all the activities of life, then the establishment of a high value diversity and acting upon it becomes possible. paras.text: … which are in Islam and the constitution of the country, then a society based on tolerance and positive diversity can be established. When no one’s right is violated, then what is there to quarrel about? If the style of life is based on the principles of cooperation, patience, peace, sacrifice, self-denial, kindness, mercy, acceptance and human respect, then in such a society diversity and tolerance will develop. In this regard the sense of civic-mindedness too has great importance. To live in society, the style of life will have to be spent in the light of collective interests instead of personal interests. In this way mutual tolerance and diversity will develop. The important thing is that when man is considered a human being rising above every kind of discrimination, then things work out.
